evidence.title: Card Folder · React motion component · beUI

name: Card Folder
summary: Animated React card that lifts out of a stitched purse pocket and opens to show its details.
description: A motion component for React and Next.js: a landscape card tucked into a purse pocket that lifts forward as the purse compresses into its bottom seam, with controlled open state, card-detail visibility and a separate overflow action. Copy the source or install it with the shadcn CLI.
contains: controlled open and details-visible props plus onAction and ariaLabel
install with the shadcn CLI (@beui/card-folder) or copy the source
needs the beUI theme tokens and shared files (lib/ease.ts, lib/utils.ts)
